shortDescription: Module to interact with rapyuta_io builds.

options.name: architecture
options.description: Strategy type to make the build. Choices are case insensitive.

options.name: branch
options.description: Branch in the repository from which to create the build.

options.name: catkin_options
options.description: Catkin options for the build if is_ros is set to True. Each Catkin option is a dictionary.

options.name: context_directory
options.description: Context dir to be used in the build.

options.name: docker_file_path
options.description: Path of Dockerfile. This path is appended to the context_directory before searching for the Dockerfile.

options.name: docker_image_repository
options.description: An external docker repository where Build will push the image. For example ‘docker.io/user/example’.

options.name: docker_pull_secret
options.description: Secret name created in rapyuta io to pull the docker image. This is valid if the strategy_type is set to docker

options.name: docker_push_secret
options.description: Secret name created in rapyuta io to push the docker image. This is valid if the strategy_type is set to docker.

options.name: enable_simulation
options.description: Whether to enable simulation in the build. Can be set to true only when is_ros is true.

options.name: is_ros
options.description: Whether the build has a ros component. If this parameter is set to true then a ros_distro is required.

options.name: present
options.description: Whether build should be present or not.

options.name: repository
options.description: Repository to make the build from.

options.name: ros_distro
options.description: Ros distribution to use for the build. This parameter is required only if the build has a ros component. Choices are case insensitive.

options.name: source_secret
options.description: Represents secret for a private git repository.

options.name: strategy_type
options.description: Strategy type to make the build. Choices are case insensitive.

options.name: tag_name
options.description: If the build is already present and the trigger option is enabled then this option sets the tag name of the docker image.

options.name: trigger
options.description: If the build is already present then this options lets you trigger the build. It is automatically set to true if there is a build with same name which failed and I(present=true).

options.name: trigger_name
options.description: If the build is already present and the trigger option is enabled then this option sets the trigger name of the docker image.
